review_evidence: HexBasic/List.lean proves reusable list results including nodup_map_on, nodup_flatMap_of_disjoint, and compareLex_zipWith rather than merely re-exporting upstream modules.
The source also owns formal interfaces and lemmas in ExactDiv, Fold, ListShim, OfFn, ExtTreeMap, Rand, Sort, and Vector/Modify that support later verified matrix and lattice algorithms.
HexBasic/ModuleBoundaryTests.lean contains checked examples of the owned APIs; these remain useful formal behavior checks and do not justify path-name-based exclusion.
summary: Retain hex-basic as substantive Mathlib-free foundational code and proofs used throughout the verified hex computational-algebra stack.

HexBasic/ExactDiv.lean: read fully; class ExactDivLaws, class DomainLaws, theorems mul_right_cancel, mul_ne_zero, one_ne_zero_of_nonzero, exactDiv lemmas, and Int/Field instances.
